title: Static Stretch Circle
description: The team forms a circle and works through a sequence of static stretches together, bringing the heart rate down and closing practice calmly.

content.objective: Lower the heart rate gradually and stretch the major muscle groups used during practice.
content.setup: The whole group forms a loose circle with enough space to stretch freely.
instructions: Hold a quad stretch on each leg for 20 seconds.
Hold a hamstring stretch on each leg for 20 seconds.
Hold a shoulder and triceps stretch on each arm for 20 seconds.
Finish with a few deep, slow breaths as a group before practice ends.
coachingPoints: Hold each stretch still, without bouncing.
Keep the mood calm — this is meant to bring the energy down, not up.
commonMistakes: Bouncing in and out of the stretch instead of holding it still.
Rushing through stretches to finish practice faster.
Rushing through it to finish practice sooner.
content.safety: Never stretch to the point of pain — a gentle pull is enough.
